title: 2024展商秀：格拉德-自行车中的“英伦风尚”
notes: 2024-04-11 exhibitor profile, likely based on exhibitor-supplied copy: names 格拉德自行车科技有限公司 / Glade Bicycle Technology Co., Ltd., says it emerged in 2015 in Lujia Town, Kunshan, Suzhou, and introduced the British-origin brand GIRDER. Describes ARROW as a full-carbon aero road bike with a new Shimano mechanical 2×12 group — a different build from the current 105 Di2 pages. No Arrow price, weight or clearance.
